description: This file defines the PduBody class, a core component in managing parts of an MMS message, including adding, removing, and retrieving parts by various identifiers.

classes.name: PduBody
classes.description: A class representing the body of a multimedia message, containing multiple PduPart instances and providing methods for managing these parts.

methods.name: PduBody
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parts collection and maps.

methods.name: addPart
methods.description: Appends a PduPart to the list and to all internal maps, throwing NullPointerException if the argument is null.

methods.name: addPart
methods.description: Inserts a PduPart at a specific index, updating internal maps, with null check.

methods.name: removePart
methods.description: Removes and returns the PduPart at a given index.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Clears all parts from the body.

methods.name: getPart
methods.description: Retrieves the PduPart at the specified index.

methods.name: getPartIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a specified PduPart within the list.

methods.name: getPartsNum
methods.description: Returns the total number of parts.

methods.name: getPartByContentId
methods.description: Retrieves a PduPart by its content ID.

methods.name: getPartByContentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a PduPart by content location.

methods.name: getPartByName
methods.description: Retrieves a PduPart by its name.
